text: I like this store because they have a wide selection of products. I regularly buy shampoo and body wash from them; they have many brands and sizes at reasonable prices. restaurant_name: เพ็ทมาร์ท สาขา หางดง
text:
The first time I paid, I was overcharged by several packets. I was suspicious when I was paying at the counter; I don't know why the employee was in such a hurry to scan the items, and it ultimately led to the mistake. Shouldn't you be more careful and attentive?

The store's products are reasonably priced, but the promotional price shown on the sign is different from the actual price at checkout. This has happened about 2-3 times. For example, I bought 12 packets for 130 baht, but the final price after the discount was 136 baht.

The most recent time, I think I went to the wrong aisle and tried to walk through the metal gate to another aisle to shop, but I didn't realize that gate was for staff only. Both sides are customer-only zones. Before I could even get past the gate, an employee loudly said, "Who opened the gate? Who gave you permission to open it?" I was confused, as I was in the customer area. Couldn't they have told me politely if the gate was off-limits?
